messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — Meridian QBR scheduled for Wed 10am PT. Need a quick stitch on slides + renewal-signal triage. Main asks: onboarding status, exec-level Ops metrics, and a short demo cadence. Can folks confirm owners?
Ajay Patel: I can take onboarding status. Will pull the integration run rate and blockers. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Taylor Brooks: I’ll own the exec metrics slide — will include token cost delta and latency SLOs. Any specific format the exec prefers?
Sofia Ruiz: Exec likes 1-slide signal summary + 1 backup slide with details. I’ll draft the signal summary and call out renewal risks (low usage, open support tickets).
Devon Li: I’ll prep the demo cadence + enablement ask. We should surface a fallback plan if the integration lag isn’t fixed.
Maya Chen: Perfect. Can we add one quick feedback capture item for product about the onboarding flow? Exec asked for NPS-ish sentiment.
Ajay Patel: Adding a short feedback snapshot from the last 30 days. Command I’ll run:
```
# query last 30 days onboarding issues
SELECT count(*) as cnt, category FROM onboarding_issues WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY category ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```
Taylor Brooks: Nice. I’ll surface cost per active user and a 3-month trend chart. Can someone attach the latest billing export?
Sofia Ruiz: Attached in the doc (link: https://redwood-internal.docs/qbr/meridian). Also adding the top 3 support threads for context.
Maya Chen: Owners recap: Ajay — onboarding + feedback snippet; Taylor — exec metrics + cost trend; Sofia — renewal signal summary + support threads; Devon — demo cadence + fallback. I’ll own slide assembly and run the rehearsal.
reminder-bot: Reminder set — QBR slide freeze on Tue 6pm PT.
Devon Li: Quick question — do we want a canary offer for Meridian if renewal risk > medium? Might propose a short-term discount + dedicated onboarding run.
Maya Chen: Good idea. Put options on a backup slide with impact estimates. Keep it compact.
Ajay Patel: One more: I'll flag any customer-specific privacy asks; Meridian mentioned an internal KMS requirement in the last call.
Taylor Brooks: Will include KMS note in the risk slide.
Sofia Ruiz: If you want, I can run a 15-min enablement sync Tue noon so the demo team knows the fallback flow.
Maya Chen: Yes please — schedule it. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
reminder-bot: Event created: "Meridian QBR run" Tue 12:00-12:15 PT — attendees: Maya Chen, Ajay Patel, Taylor Brooks, Sofia Ruiz, Devon Li.
